decisions.reason: As a close-to-core handcrafted line with several models, it is still relatively inexpensive to keep available, and there is not enough negative evidence to justify abandoning it now.
This product fits directly into the firm's established Christmas pyramid business, so management would usually retain it as a low-risk catalog option unless sales weakness became unmistakable.
Because the main electronic music box platform was already withdrawn, this complementary add-on has little remaining option value and is now the most natural candidate for resource reallocation.
It builds on the firm's proven pyramid craftsmanship and likely remains a manageable thematic variant whose upside still outweighs the low cost of keeping it in the assortment.
